solution.text:
Resonating structure of carbonate CO32- ion are

In resonating structures bonds are not fixed and therefore, all bond lengths are equal.

The hybridisation of central atom is sp2.

Thus, there is no coordinate bond present in CO32-. Hence, the second statement is incorrect.
